newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Aokam tumbles after poor year results.
newsitem.headline: Aokam tumbles after poor year results.

text.p: Shares of logging concern Aokam Perdana Bhd dropped in heavy volume on Tuesday after the company reported a year loss of 144.73 million ringgit that far exceeded market expectations, analysts said.
The loss, which compared with estimates of an 8-10 million ringgit loss and a "worst case" figure of 20 million, was after a profit of 47.04 million in the year-ago period which ended in June.
Shares of Aokam, long a favourite of punters, sank 12 cents to 4.06 ringgit in late morning, on most-active volume of over 4.5 million shares. "These are horrendous results," said one analyst.

Haizan Johari, an analyst at Schroder Research, said, "The tell-tale signs were there that Aokam was having a log sourcing problem. However, we never expected the situation to be amplified to this magnitude."
Aokam said in a statement accompanying its results that weak timber prices and insufficient log supply affected production volume and costs.

Analysts said they still had many questions about the results, and that it was difficult to figure out future estimates. "I really have to play around with my numbers," one said, adding that the outlook for timber had been improving.
